rationale: The current best trains the earlier recurrent tail pass at low gain but evaluates the final int8 roundtrip at full gain. This surgical wrapper patches state/best_script.py to blend that tail gain upward only during the quant-aware endgame, preserving the winning reverse-tail/export path while reducing the late train/eval recurrence mismatch without enabling intermediate validation.
title: Quant-Aware Tail Recurrence Gain Bridge
